note: Counter-current O2 exchange along one gill lamella (model: countercurrent.js). params are the dimensionless reference set the viewer animates: k = D/Gw (gill O2 transfer over water capacitance rate), ratio = Gw/Gb (water over blood capacitance rate). Reference = rainbow trout at rest, ~10 degC, Hb-curve solution linearised (beta_b = (Ca-Cv)/(Pa-Pv)). No flying-fish gill data were found. No bird data used.

Pw_in.source: inspired water PO2 = 0.2095 x (101.325 - pH2O(10 degC)); air-saturated water assumed; Magnus pH2O (standard formula, not fetched)

Pb_in.source: venous PO2 from O2 balance: Cv = Ca - MO2/Q with trout Q 26.3 ml/min/kg (sundell2018), MO2 66.2 ml/kg/h (bigman2021 dataset, White et al. 2012), Ca = C(15.8 kPa) on the trout Hill curve (rummer2015)

k.source: D tuned so the counter-current Hb solution gives PaO2 = 15.8 kPa (mcarley2022, resting trout); k = D/Gw

ratio.source: Gw/(Q beta_b) with Gw = (Vw/Q = 10, assumed) x Q x beta_w; beta_w = air-saturated fresh water O2 at 10 degC (11.29 mg/l, Garcia & Gordon 1992 fit via TEOS-10 GSW-C) / Pw_in

physical_reference_trout_per_kg.note: Same gill, same flows, same Hb: co-current blood leaves at the PO2 above; it can never exceed the water outlet PO2.

flying_fish_default_0p06kg.note: createPhysiology({mass_kg: 0.06}, {}) with baseline env (25 degC, 35 psu, air O2 0.209, air-saturated); every input is a proxy/assumption (see index.js describe()).

secondary_lamella_length.note: printed as 239 +/- 25 mm in Table 1, which cannot be right for a lamella on a 4534 um filament; almost certainly um

lamella_geometry.use: viewer geometry only; the exchange model is dimensionless along the lamella

gill_area_per_body_mass.note: From the bigman2021 dataset (PairedRSAData.csv), which compiles the original measurements named. No Exocoetidae / Beloniformes entry exists in it; no flying-fish gill area found in Europe PMC or Crossref.
gill_area_per_body_mass.default_used: Scomber scombrus (closest mass among active pelagics); gill area scales below-isometrically with mass, so a 60 g fish may have more area per gram than any row here

ventilation.flying_fish: unknown. No fetched source says whether flying fish ram-ventilate or use buccal-opercular pumping.

evidence_in_other_teleosts.claim: scombrids and billfishes are ram ventilators; their gill design (high lamellar frequency, long low lamellae) reflects ram ventilation
a small tropical pelagic (scaled sardine, Harengula jaguana) shows a progressive transition from opercular-buccal to ram ventilation with swimming speed
ram ventilation while swimming may raise arterial O2 content in schoolmaster snapper

ventilation.model: both modes are the same exchanger; only Vw differs. In air (taxi/glide/flight) the gills are treated as not ventilated.

proxy: Oncorhynchus mykiss (Hb curve, PaO2, Q, MO2, lamellar geometry)
Lutjanus apodus (warm-water Q, MO2 in index.js)
assumed: same diffusion barrier per m2 in flying fish as trout
